key_insight: HISPO improves RLVR credit assignment by splitting long reasoning traces into entropy-derived segments and applying importance-sampling correction at the segment level, between token-level and sequence-level methods.
engineering_relevance: For mathematical reasoning models, segment-level optimization offers a practical way to stabilize training and better reward the parts of a solution that matter most.
method: Build rollout-time contiguous segments from entropy signals
Assign soft saliency weights to segments based on entropy
Apply clipped importance-sampling correction at segment granularity
evidence_signal: Fine-tuning Qwen3-1.7B-Base on six math benchmarks, HISPO achieved the strongest Pass@8 on all six and matched or exceeded the strongest Acc@8 on five, including gains on AIME25 over GRPO and GSPO.
watch_item: Segment construction depends on entropy-derived heuristics, so performance may be sensitive to segmentation choices and implementation details.
paper_title: HISPO: Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization with Entropy-Derived Segments
